```sql
with departure_delays as (
  select
    airport,
    mean(arr_delay_sum) as mean_arr_delay
  from
    turnaround.mart_airport_day
  where
    year(flight_date) = 2022
  group by
    airport
)
select
  airport as label,
  mean_arr_delay as value
from
  departure_delays
order by
  mean_arr_delay desc, airport
```

```sql
with Charlotte as (
    select city as airport, sum(departure_delay_sum) / sum(flight_date) as mean_delay
    from turnaround.mart_airport_day
    where airport = 'CLT' and year(flight_date) = 2022
    group by city
),
PortlandInternational as (
    select city as airport, sum(departure_delay_sum) / sum(flight_date) as mean_delay
    from turnaround.mart_airport_day
    where airport = 'PDX' and year(flight_date) = 2022
    group by city
)
select airport as label, max(mean_delay) as value from Charlotte as clt join PortlandInternational as pdt on clt.city = pdt.city order by value desc
```

```sql
  t1.total_permits as value
```

```sql
    where carrier in ('UA', 'WN') and year = 2019
),
average_delays as (
    select 
        u.total_dep_delay_sum / u.carry_count as avg_dep_delay_sum,
        d.total_dep_delay_pos_sum / d.carry_count as avg_dep_delay_pos_sum
    from (
        select 
            carrier,
            sum(scheduled) as carry_count,
            sum(dep_delay_sum) as total_dep_delay_sum,
            sum(dep_delay_pos_sum) as total_dep_delay_pos_sum
        from turnaround.mart_carrier_month
        where year = 2019
        group by carrier
    ) as u
    join delays as d on u.carrier = d.carrier
)
select 
    u.carrier as label,
    u.avg_dep_delay_sum as value1,
    d.avg_dep_delay_pos_sum as value2
from average_delays as u
join delays as d on u.carrier = d.carrier
order by value1 desc, value2 desc
```

```sql
with quarters as (
    select first_month, months, year, month,
           sum(adjusted_net_income) as adjusted_net_income,
           sum(capital_ratio) as capital_ratio,
           sum(loan_loss_reserve) as loan_loss_reserve,
           sum(provision) as provision
    from ledger.metrics_bank_quarter
    where period between '2024Q1' and '2026Q2'
    group by months, year, month
),
profits as (
    select rank() over (partition by quarters.year ORDER BY quarters.adjusted_net_income / quarters.capital_ratio / quarters.loan_loss_reserve / quarters.provision DESC) as profit_rank,
           quarters.*
    from quarters
)
select quarters.year as quarter, quarters.month as month, quarters.first_month as quarter_start, quarters.adjusted_net_income / quarters.capital_ratio / quarters.loan_loss_reserve / quarters.provision as profit
from profits
where profit_rank = 1
order by quarter
```

```sql
        t1.year,
        t1.carrier,

        and t1.year = t2.year

    from

        t2.average_change,
        t1.on_time as current_on_time,
        t1.on_time - t2.average_change as on_time_change
    from
        on_time_change t1
    cross join
        on_time_average t2
)
```
